operation_policy: Validate every raw frame, then compare each operation final observed geometry and paint projection; use preceding observed frame for a no-redraw input operation. Never pair redraw counts.
source_projection: Filter actual Rust paint-entry callbacks by authored box labels. Compare with actual candidate Quad commands in emission order, retaining command.id() and genuine tree bounds. Transparent authored boxes retain zero-alpha Quad commands. Projection is source-derived; Rust trace is not a scene-primitive dump.
unmapped_structure: Retain all actual Rust request_layout/prepaint/paint entry+return callbacks and candidate helper/attachment nodes. Candidate core has no corresponding per-node lifecycle callback API; no callback parity claim. Extra candidate zero-size positioning/reference wrappers are explicit and never compared as Rust callbacks.
input_policy: Retain every Rust mouse_down callback and actual candidate hit_test, dispatch_input, dispatch_input_with callback visits for both down/up. Report per-operation side-by-side callback/route differences with input_parity_established=false, regardless of coincidental target agreement. Do not emulate GPUI listener occlusion or stop_propagation in the candidate.
input_gaps: core keeps existing reverse-paint topmost hit and structural capture/bubble routing
control_gate: Reopen source-bound ordinary pair and all same-core regressions before each control. Compile genuine isolated one-site production mutants. Require successful build, execution, exact input/token transport and structurally valid trace, then exact predeclared paint_order mismatch witnesses. Build/runtime/transport/validation failure is not a semantic kill.
